subject: POC trial planning - RACI, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial planning - RACI, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of discovery
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for patient triage and clinical note summarization workflows (throughput target ~60 qps during business hours; 95th p99 latency target <= 350ms per request).
- Primary evaluation focus: accuracy of summaries vs. clinician baseline, latency under simulated load, and integration with your EHR anonymization pipeline.

Proposed POC / trial plan (high level)
1) Prep (Week 1) — exchange network allowlists, sign MFA/KMS requirements, agree success criteria (attached file: success_criteria.xlsx).
2) Pilot deployment (Week 2-3) — Redwood private trial deployment in your staging VPC; run synthetic load and small set of real anonymized notes.
3) Evaluation (Week 4) — run evaluation dataset, collect quality metrics, cost/latency numbers; review with clinical and infra teams.

Ownership / RACI (initial)
- Clearwater infra: provide VPC, peering, IP allowlist, and a point-of-contact for firewall rules (owner: Samir / IT).
- Clearwater app: provide integration engineer and test dataset mapping (owner: TBD from your App team).
- Clearwater security & compliance: lead review of SOC2, dataflow, KMS/HSM requirements (owner: Maya Chen).
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) — POC coordinator and timeline owner; Lauren (SE) — trial deployment and validation; Dev Patel (Solutions Eng) — infra/network handoff and deployment automation.

Attachments: POC_Plan_v1.docx, success_criteria.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf

Immediate asks / next steps
- Please confirm: primary infra owner (who we should loop for VPC/network) and the app owner for integration testing.
- Are the proposed timelines (start next week) reasonable?
- Any additional compliance docs we should send now (SOC 2, encryption attestation)?

I’ll loop back with Lauren and Dev to draft a RACI spreadsheet once we have names.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: POC_Plan_v1.docx (document), success_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: Samir Desai <samir@clearwaterhealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwaterhealth.org>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@clearwaterhealth.org>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - RACI, success criteria, and next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and plan. Appreciate the timeline. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Infra owner: I will own the infra coordination (Samir Desai, IT Ops lead). I’ll also loop in our cloud network engineer (cc: procurement for procurement timing).
- App owner: I’m assigning this to Priya Natarajan (lead integration engineer) — I’ll introduce her in a follow up.
- Security: Maya (cc’d) will lead the compliance review; she asked to confirm we receive SOC2 Type II and our encryption key management whitepaper.

Timing: Week 1 prep next week works for us, but procurement will need a short SOW and a statement of work for any reserved capacity — procurement@clearwaterhealth.org to outline contract timeline (they typically need 2-3 weeks).

A couple of additions to the success criteria: 
- Uptime / availability target during pilot (99.5%).
- Data residency: all logs and eval data must remain in our AWS account and be retained per our policy for 90 days.

Thanks — I’ll circulate Priya and our network engineer in the next email.

Samir Desai
IT Operations Lead | Clearwater Health
samir@clearwaterhealth.org

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@clearwaterhealth.org>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - RACI, success criteria, and next steps

Lauren / Dev —

Looping you in for action items based on Samir’s notes. Key asks: 
1) Lauren — please draft the RACI spreadsheet (who on Redwood owns: deployment automation, monitoring, rollback/fallback policy, and evaluation metrics collection). Use Samir as the Clearwater infra owner and mark Priya as app owner once introduced.
2) Dev — can you prepare the VPC peering checklist and the automation script we’ll use to deploy the trial (we’ll share as IaC template). Attach network_requirements.pdf as a starting point.
3) Compliance docs — I’ve uploaded our SOC2 summary and KMS integration notes to the shared doc link (see related_links). If security needs anything else, we’ll provide detailed evidence.

Proposed owners on Redwood side (please confirm or adjust):
- Deployment & infra liaison: Dev Patel (Solutions Eng)
- Trial validation & quality metrics: Lauren Bishop (Sales Engineer)
- Contract / SOW coordination: Marissa Cole (AE)

Scheduling: Samir indicated procurement lead time ~2-3 weeks for SOW. Let’s aim to start Week 2 for pilot prep tasks that don’t require signed SOW (network allowlist and security review).

I’ll follow up with a draft RACI by EOD.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@clearwaterhealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Samir Desai <samir@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwaterhealth.org>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - RACI, success criteria, and next steps

Marissa / Samir —

Quick security check-in. A few items we need before we can greenlight the trial in our staging environment: 
1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) or attestation summary.
2) KMS/HSM integration note and contact at Redwood for key management (we require envelope encryption and audit logs).
3) Network diagram for the trial deployment and specific egress IPs for allowlisting (if you can provide the IaC template, that helps).
4) Confirmation of log retention and access controls — logs must be stored in our AWS account and retained for 90 days; access limited to named persons.

If you can provide items 1-3 by next Tue (12 May), we can stay on the proposed schedule. Otherwise procurement may push the start.

Thanks,
Maya Chen
Security & Compliance Manager | Clearwater Health
maya.chen@clearwaterhealth.org
